items.title: Muracha Matcha Pop-Up at Bella Cucina
menu: Collector's Set: Yame No. 89 and Uji No. 18 first-harvest tins, whisk, chashaku
items.description: A holiday-season matcha bar at the Buckhead Village shop Bella Cucina, with Muracha serving matcha and selling its tins and tools. A limited Collector's Set made with artist Kristen Giorgi is on sale. Free to attend; no purchase needed.
items.notes: Date, time and street address on the shop event page. The page's price field reads $0.00 and is not a drink price; drink prices are not listed. Part of the winter-market sweep (holiday-season shop pop-up, not an organizer market).

items.title: Tsukime Matcha Bar at Occidental Flea Market
items.hours: 12:00-1:00 PM per the brand page; the market itself runs about noon to 5 pm
items.description: Tsukime is a traveling Seattle matcha cart serving ceremonial-grade matcha drinks. This stop is at the quarterly Occidental Square flea in Pioneer Square, a free outdoor market of handmade and vintage goods.
items.notes: Brand page lists Sat Dec 12 2026 12-1 PM with the address; the one-hour window looks short (earlier listings are also 12-1) so the time may be a stub. Downtown Seattle Association page only shows the Oct 17 edition; Dec 12 market date is on thecraftmap and Secret Seattle, not yet on the DSA page. Menu and prices not published.
